market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are an established mid-table Premier League club with strong financial backing and a squad clearly superior to relegation-level sides. They have finished between 7th and 14th in the last four seasons and have not been in serious danger of the drop. Even accounting for managerial changes or squad turnover by 2025–26, the true probability of relegation is far below the market's 34.5%.
evidence_points: West Ham have avoided relegation for 12 consecutive Premier League seasons.
Club investment and squad depth are well above typical candidates like newly promoted sides.
Even in a worst-case scenario, mid-season managerial replacement typically stabilizes clubs of this size.
sources_consulted: West Ham United recent seasons performance
